title: This is my attempt to get Vulkan going on NetBSD
summary: A developer is attempting to implement Vulkan graphics API support on NetBSD, an open-source Unix-like operating system known for its portability across hardware platforms. This is a porting project that addresses the lack of modern GPU API support on NetBSD.
problem_solved: Enables Vulkan graphics API support on NetBSD, which currently lacks native support for modern GPU-accelerated rendering.
why_valuable: Expands NetBSD's graphics capabilities to support modern games and GPU-intensive applications, leveraging NetBSD's reputation for portability across diverse hardware platforms.
